protocol.selection: One fixed specification; no feature, model, threshold, ensemble-weight or hyperparameter search; no early stopping; no public-score input; never select or revise from report-year metrics.
protocol.risk_set: Non-polyurethane pipes installed by year start (unknown installation dates retained); remove pipes whose first observed leak precedes year start. Label is first observed leak during that year.
protocol.cost_target: Raw nonnegative event Cost in train.csv, using original inventory attributes and age at event-year start; every supplied event retained. No log transform, learned smearing or tail clipping.
protocol.missing: Unknown material/surface are explicit categories. Missing length/age are NaN with flags, handled by CatBoost. Unknown material is not assigned zero risk.
protocol.year_features: No calendar year, installation cohort, coordinate, neighborhood, target encoding, historical target aggregate, pipe ID or manually overwritten probability in inputs.
protocol.evaluation: Expanding-year descriptive backtest. Each report year is predicted by a model fit only on preceding years. These years were previously inspected in other experiments and are NOT an untouched holdout.
protocol.long_horizon: No calibrated long-horizon claim; release forecasts for 2027 only.
protocol.acceptance: Accept on data-integrity and reproducibility checks, independent of metric values. No official evaluator submission or public-score comparison in this update.
protocol.limitation: Frozen after prior project-wide exploration: cannot erase historical knowledge or guarantee absence of adaptive bias. This is a prospective process reset, not a preregistration made before the data existed. Accuracy improvement is not claimed.
